description: The core handlers of KEY_DOWN_COMMAND, BEFORE_INPUT_COMMAND and the composition commands, off Apple platforms: which command each event dispatches, with which payload, and what rich text then does.

cases.name: copy and cut keys at a node selection dispatch the commands with the key event
copy and cut keys without a selection are left to the platform
rich text: formatting keys, undo and redo
rich text: Enter, Shift+Enter and select all
rich text: deletion keys at a range selection
Shift+Enter makes the next insertParagraph a line break
deleteContentBackward without a selection takes the previous one and stops
selectionchange: points, format and style, and the notification
rich text: insertText and deleteContentBackward with a root element
composition: the composed text stays selected until it ends
composition: the composed node is not transformed, then merges
composition: ending with a line break inserts a paragraph
composition: ending on a token node puts the text beside it
composition: does not start without a range selection
